email.subject: Pickup request
email.body:
To whom it may concern,

We require transportation of goods from our facility at 2955 Boul. Industriel, Laval QC H7L 4R9. Please pick up on Friday Nov 20 at 11:00 and deliver to 1200 Cyrville Rd, Ottawa ON K1B 3L8 on Monday Nov 23 before 17:00.

10 skids of plastic housewares, 7,900 lbs. Dry van. Please reply with your best price.

Regards,
Shipping Department
